name: cl_fx_fvg_ema20side_15_p37

source.title: Claude design panel 2026-10-20, falsify lens: PLACEBO-ANCHOR control for the open-side FVG leader -- the plain 15-minute FVG retest (cl_fx_fvg_noside_15_p37) with ONE change: a generic trend side (the 20-bar EMA of 15-minute closes, the displacement rule's gate) instead of the 09:30 open. The owner's cause says the 09:30 open marks who took control of the day, so the faders of the open's side pay; if any trend side buys the same edge, the 09:30 open is not the cause and the rule is just 'FVGs with the short trend'.

entry.words: Any 15-minute fair value gap of the session pass at least 0.1 x ATR(14) high: a limit at its near edge, with the gap, but a long only when the gap's close is above the 20-bar EMA of 15-minute closes and a short only below it. The newest gap replaces an older resting order. No new order from 15:00. Stop 37 points, target 37 points (1:1). One trade per session pass.

taught: [owner 2026-10-06, families/fvg.py] the fair value gap as an entry trigger: a limit at the gap's near edge, with the gap
[chat 2026-10-19, sheet cl_fvg_oside_15_mid_r1_t2_gap0p1] NQ, 15-minute bars, 1:1, gaps at least 0.1 x ATR
[owner 2026-10-18, sheet cl_disp15_ema_allday_k1p5] the EMA20 side gate of the 15-minute displacement rule

[Claude design panel 2026-10-20] PLACEBO CONTROL: the 09:30-open side is replaced by the EMA20 side on the plain fvg control (one gate added to cl_fx_fvg_noside_15_p37, nothing else changed); stop and target fixed at 37 points
not_run: THE SIDE IS THE EMA20's, NOT THE 09:30 OPEN'S, ON PURPOSE: this is a placebo control, not a strategy.
THE STOP: 37 points fixed, not the middle candle's extreme (the leader's median stop, the size its random control used).

ENGINE DIFFERENCES FROM THE LEADER (fvg, not fvg_oside): one instance per session pass, a gap cannot span 11:00 or 13:30, one per pass (up to three a day), the newest gap of either side replaces the resting order even when the gate then blocks it.
THE GATE: (close - EMA20) / ATR(14) above 0 for a long, below 0 for a short, read at the gap's close on closed 15-minute bars; the EMA restarts at 00:00 ET (seeded with the day's first close).
WINDOW: no new order from 15:00 (w_end); an order placed before 15:00 may still fill after it.
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage, $4 a round turn, tick replay, strict limit fills).
THE TEST DAYS (2025-07-01 on) ARE NOT READ: build days only.
FLAT: every trade is flat by 15:58 ET (13:13 on half days).
